description: Report that a notification candidate from check_project_changes was delivered to the user, as reported by the host (host-reported acknowledgement — the receipt is a host-supplied string, e.g. the scheduled-task run id; the server records it but does NOT verify it, so this is not proof a human saw the notification and never purchase or reward evidence). This is the ONLY way a notification becomes 'delivered': the server never claims delivery on its own, and notified_at / notified_fingerprint in the check state are set only here. A candidate that is never acked is never counted as delivered, and the same change may be notified again. Requires project_id, the notif_id from the check response, and a receipt. Owner credential, or that project's own pt_ token.
name: notification_ack
title: Acknowledge a notification delivery
